questions.question_text: Illustrate Mendel's Law of Independent Assortment using phenotypic outcomes of a Dihybrid Cross between Round Yellow (RRYY) and Wrinkled Green (rryy) pea plants.
options: Option A
Option B
Option C
Option D
questions.correct_answer: F1 generation yields all Round Yellow (RrYy). Selfing F1 (RrYy x RrYy) yields F2 phenotypic ratio 9 Round Yellow : 3 Round Green : 3 Wrinkled Yellow : 1 Wrinkled Green.
